# Changelog Fragments

This directory contains changelog fragments managed by [Changie](https://changie.dev/).

## Structure

- `unreleased/` - Contains changelog entries for unreleased changes
- `header.tpl.md` - Template for the CHANGELOG.md header
- `v*.md` - Released version changelog fragments (generated by changie)

## Usage

To add a new changelog entry, run:

```bash
changie new
```

This will create a new file in the `unreleased/` directory.

When a release is made, all unreleased changes are merged into a version-specific file and added to the main CHANGELOG.md.

## Do Not Edit Manually

Files in this directory are managed by Changie. Please use the `changie` command to add or modify changelog entries.
